name: Caleb Desktop Pet
features: local chat history and long-term habit memory
configurable Ctrl trigger and optional right-Alt voice toggle
privacy: Nickname, interaction data, AI history, and AI memory are stored locally. AI questions and selected conversation context are sent only when the user presses send. No keystroke contents or audio recording is stored by the pet. Optional user-selected city queries Open-Meteo.
known_limits: Climbing artwork not approved; feature not enabled
Voice toggle sends a right-Alt shortcut to the active input method; transcription depends on the installed input method
AI requires the user's own compatible API key, network access, and provider account
